1. Acceptance of Terms

These Terms and Conditions constitute a legally binding agreement between you (referred to as the "Student", "User", "Client", or "You") and Amrit Yoga Center™ (also known as अमृत योग केंद्र), operating from Bhilwara, Rajasthan, India (referred to as the "Center", "We", "Us", or "Our").

These terms govern your access to our website, digital communication services, trial bookings, and participation in both physical studio batches and virtual online training sessions. If you do not agree to all terms stated herein, you must refrain from accessing our website and enrolling in our programs.

2. Eligibility & Admission Registration

  • Age Requirement: Adult fitness and wellness batches are open to individuals aged 18 and older. Minors between the ages of 5 and 17 may enroll exclusively in our Kids Yoga Academy or Competitive Sports Yogasana Batches with the written consent and registration confirmation of a parent or legal guardian.
  • Accurate Details: When completing trial booking forms or admission registers, you warrant that all information provided (including full legal name, phone number, address, and age) is genuine, complete, and accurate.
  • Right to Refuse Admission: The administration reserves the right to decline admission or trial session requests at its discretion to maintain studio capacity limits and safety standards.

3. Scope of Services & Training Programs

Amrit Yoga Center provides professional, discipline-based yogic instruction directed by National Gold Medalist Suresh Mali across several specialized domains:

  1. In-Studio Regular Classes: Structured daily batches conducted at our primary studio (3-M-7, 2nd Floor, Near Vinay Stationers, Govt. Hospital Road, Bapunagar, Bhilwara).
  2. Live Interactive Online Classes: High-definition virtual training sessions for remote students across India and overseas.
  3. Specialized Therapeutic Yoga: Targeted rehabilitation routines for chronic back pain, sciatica, cervical spondylosis, joint arthritis, thyroid imbalance, PCOS/PCOD, and metabolic disorders.
  4. Competition & Sports Yogasana Coaching: Advanced flexibility training, balance holds, and score sheet preparation for district, state, and national championship athletes.
  5. Complimentary Demo Trial Session: Prospective students may be offered one (1) complimentary demo trial session per person. Trial slots are strictly subject to schedule availability and prior confirmation by our admissions desk.

4. Health, Physical Exercise & Medical Disclaimer

CRITICAL MEDICAL & SAFETY WARNING: Yoga involves physical exertion, muscular stretching, inversion poses, and intensive breath control (Pranayama). You are solely responsible for ensuring that you are physically capable of undertaking these exercises.

By registering for or participating in any training session, you explicitly agree to the following:

  • Physician Consultation: You confirm that you have consulted with a qualified medical practitioner regarding your ability to practice physical yoga, or that you voluntarily accept full personal responsibility for practicing without prior medical clearance.
  • Mandatory Disclosure of Conditions: You must immediately inform your instructor (Coach Suresh Mali) prior to beginning class regarding any pre-existing health concerns, including but not limited to:
    • Spinal disc herniation, slip disc, or spondylitis;
    • Cardiovascular conditions, high or low blood pressure;
    • Recent surgical procedures, bone fractures, or ligament tears;
    • Pregnancy or post-partum conditions (which require certified prenatal modifications);
    • Severe vertigo, epilepsy, or retinal detachment issues.
  • Assumption of Risk: You acknowledge that physical training carries inherent risks of muscular strain, sprains, or joint injury. You voluntarily assume all risks associated with participation.
  • Listen to Your Body: Instructors provide guidance and alignment recommendations, but you must honor your own body's limits. Never push past sharp pain or dizziness. Discontinue any pose immediately if discomfort occurs.
  • Not a Substitute for Medical Care: Therapeutic yoga practices offered at Amrit Yoga Center are intended as complementary lifestyle and physical conditioning aids. They do not constitute licensed medical diagnosis, clinical healthcare, or surgical advice.

5. Fees, Subscriptions & Payment Terms

  • Transparent Pricing: Course fees, monthly batch subscriptions, personal training retainers, and workshop charges are communicated transparently before admission. There are no hidden processing fees.
  • Advance Payment: All session fees and monthly tuition must be paid in full in advance prior to the commencement of the chosen batch cycle.
  • Accepted Payment Channels: Payments may be made via verified digital methods (UPI, Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, Net Banking, Debit/Credit Cards) or official studio cash receipt counters.
  • Timely Renewals: To guarantee reservation of your morning or evening batch slot, renewals must be completed on or before the cycle expiration date.

6. Refund, Cancellation & Membership Freeze Policy

To uphold operational stability and maintain batch size limits, Amrit Yoga Center operates under the following refund and cancellation framework:

  • General Non-Refundability: Once a student attends the first class of an enrolled batch, tuition and registration fees are non-refundable and non-transferable under normal circumstances.
  • Membership Freeze / Extension on Medical Grounds: If a student experiences unforeseen medical illness, fracture, or hospitalization that precludes physical exercise:
    • The student may submit written notification and valid medical proof to contact@amrityogacenter.in.
    • The remaining active membership days may be frozen for up to 30 to 60 days, or transferred to an immediate family member upon written approval by the director.
  • Studio Rescheduling or Cancellations: If Amrit Yoga Center is compelled to cancel or reschedule sessions due to statutory public holidays, emergency weather conditions, or facility maintenance, equivalent compensatory makeup sessions or subscription extensions will be granted.

7. Studio Etiquette & Code of Conduct

Amrit Yoga Center is a sanctuary for holistic discipline, mental focus, and well-being. All students agree to uphold the following standards:

  • Punctuality: Arrive at the studio at least 5 to 10 minutes prior to your batch start time. Late arrivals disrupt meditation and joint warm-ups.
  • Footwear & Hygiene: Outdoor shoes must be deposited in the designated shoe rack before entering the wooden practice floor. Clean attire and personal hygiene are mandatory.
  • Personal Yoga Mats: For personal hygiene, students are encouraged to bring their own yoga mats and clean towels.
  • Mobile Devices: Mobile phones must be switched to silent mode upon entering the premises. Voice calls inside practice halls are strictly prohibited.
  • Respect & Zero Harassment: We maintain zero tolerance for abusive, disrespectful, or discriminatory behavior directed toward instructors, female practitioners, or fellow classmates. Any violation will result in immediate expulsion without refund.

8. Terms for Live Online Classes

For students enrolled in virtual interactive batches:

  • You are responsible for arranging a secure, clear, and hazard-free home practice space with a stable internet connection.
  • Webcams should be positioned so that the instructor can clearly view full-body alignments from the side and front to offer real-time posture corrections.
  • Recording, capturing, screen-sharing, or distributing live streaming classes without prior written permission is strictly prohibited under copyright law.

9. Certificate Verification System (`/certificates`)

Our online portal (https://amrityogacenter.in/certificates) allows students and employers to verify authentic certificates:

  • Certificates are issued strictly upon successful completion of required attendance hours, practical asana evaluations, and theoretical examinations.
  • Tampering with, altering, forging, or publishing falsified digital certificates bearing the name or seal of Amrit Yoga Center constitutes criminal fraud and will be prosecuted under the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the Indian Penal Code.
